blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Individual tree crown segmentation from aerial imagery underpins tree-level carbon accounting, biodiversity, and restoration monitoring at landscape scale. However, existing models are predominantly trained on dense canopy forest imagery and degrade in savannah and drylands, where tree crowns are sparse, of variable appearance, and significantly underrepresented in annotated benchmarks. These models also typically depend on costly polygon crown annotations. We introduce LACE (LAtent Commonality Expectation-maximisation), a box-supervised instance segmentation model, evaluated on 0.1 m/px aerial RGB tree crown imagery. LACE uses a frozen DINOv3-web ViT-L/16 encoder, applied at four spatial offsets and interlaced into a denser feature grid, with a lightweight CenterNet-style detection head trained solely on bounding boxes. We use expectation-maximisation to separate recurring appearance, the “treeness”, within bounding boxes from surroundings. On the OAM-TCD benchmark test set, LACE reaches a mask AP 50 of 0.663 ± 0.001 0.663\pm 0.001 (3 seeds) trained on 900 box-annotated images and without mask annotations, above the 0.626 scored by Restor Foundation’s released mask-supervised Mask R-CNN, which was trained on the full ∼ \sim 4.2k image set. On a sparse-canopy holdout set, mask AP 50 rises to 0.691 0.691 versus 0.612 0.612 for a mask-supervised baseline Detectree2. On NeonTreeEvaluation, using the official evaluation code, LACE reaches 0.728 ± 0.003 0.728\pm 0.003 F1@0.4 (5 seeds) from 23,424 hand-annotated RGB boxes alone, matching the authors’ DeepForest model’s published 0.719, while using under 0.1 % 0.1\% of its training annotations i.e. without the LiDAR-derived 30M-crown pretraining set. By leveraging frozen self-supervised features, LACE matches or surpasses fully-supervised specialist baselines from boxes alone, removing the need for polygon annotation in tree crown instance segmentation for sparse-canopy environments where labelled data is scarce.
blocks.zh: 空中图像中的个别树冠分化支持了树级碳核算、生物多样性和景观规模的恢复监测。 然而,现有模型主要是在林冠茂密的森林图象方面接受培训,并在树冠稀少的草原和旱地退化,其外观多变,在附加说明的基准中代表性明显不足。 这些模型也通常依赖于昂贵的多边形冠状图谱. 我们引入了LACE(Latent Community Expection-maximization),这是一个由箱监督的实例分割模型,以0.1 m/px空中RGB树冠图象评价. LACE使用冷冻的DINOv3-web ViT-L/16编码器,在4个空间偏移处应用,并插入更稠密的特征网格,轻量级CenterNet式检测头只训练在边框上. 我们利用期望最大化的方法,把反复出现的外观,即“树木”与周围的边框分开。 在OAM-TCD基准测试集上,LACE达到了0.663±0.001 0.663\pm 0.001(3个种子)的口罩AP50,在900盒附加说明且无口罩说明的图像上训练,高于Restor基金会释放的口罩监督的Mask R-CNN的0.626分数,后者在 \sim 4.2k 完整图像集上训练. 在一个零星的隐蔽装置上,面具AP 50为0.691 0.691,相对于0.612 0.612为面具监督基线探测器2。 在NeonTree评价中,仅使用官方评价代码,LACE就从23,424个手工附加的RGB箱中就达到了0.728±0.003 0.728\pm 0.003 F1@0.4 (5种子),与作者们匹配. DeepForest 模型发布了 0. 719,同时使用了不到 0. 1% 的 0. 1% 的训练说明,即没有 LiDAR 衍生的 30M 的预训集。 通过利用冷冻的自我监督特性,LACE匹配或超过完全监督的专家基线,仅从盒子中就不需要在树冠实例分解中为贴有标签的数据稀缺的树冠环境提供多边形注释。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurate measurement of individual tree crowns can serve as a proxy for woody biomass estimation via allometries [ 1 , 2 ] and thereby enable monitoring of carbon sequestration within areas containing trees since carbon content can be derived from woody biomass. Measurement techniques in this domain have traditionally focused on dense canopy areas and forests, but there is an increasing body of literature that highlights the limitations of this approach as distribution, density, cover, and carbon content of trees in sparse-canopy biomes (biomes where trees occur at low canopy cover: savannah, shrubland and arid to semi-arid dryland; Table 6 lists the WWF biomes we treat as such) are not well understood at sub-continental to continental scales [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Recent studies highlight that the global contribution of sparse-canopy biomes as a carbon sink is underestimated due to the underestimation of tree mass in sparse-canopy areas [ 2 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Moreover, approximately 1/4 of all trees globally are located in grassland, savanna, desert and tundra biomes [ 8 ] , and 29% of Africa’s tree cover lies outside areas classified as forest [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 对单个树冠进行准确的测量,可用作通过所有采石场[1,2]对木质生物量进行估计的替代,从而能够监测含树区内的碳固存情况,因为碳含量可以来自木质生物量。 该领域的测量技术传统上侧重于林冠密集区和森林,但越来越多的文献强调了这种方法的局限性,如树冠稀少生物群落中的树木的分布、密度、覆盖和碳含量(树冠覆盖率低的生物群落:草原、灌木地和干旱至半干旱旱地;表6列出了我们所处理的WWF生物群落)在次大陆至大陆尺度上没有得到很好的理解[2、3、4]。 最近的研究突出表明,由于对稀树区树木质量的低估[2、5、6、7],稀树冠状生物群落作为碳汇的全球贡献被低估。 此外,全球约有四分之一的树木位于草原、草原、沙漠和苔原生物群落中[8],29%的非洲树木覆盖面积位于被划为森林的地区之外[9]。

blocks.en: Several conventional methodologies have been applied to the measurement of tree cover and biomass, including field inventories of plots [ 10 ] , statistical sampling [ 11 ] and hybrid solutions pairing plots with Remote Sensing (RS) covariates such as optical, multispectral, and LiDAR sensors [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] . Machine learning and deep learning applied to satellite and UAV data have since shifted the field from aggregate cover fractions toward mapping every individual tree: Brandt et al. [ 5 ] mapped over 1.8 billion crowns across 1.3 million km 2 \mathrm{km}^{2} of the Sahara and Sahel from 0.5 m imagery; Tucker et al. [ 2 ] extended this to carbon estimation over 9.9 billion trees. Reiner et al. [ 9 ] found that 29% of Africa’s tree cover lies outside areas previously classified as forest. Mugabowindekwe et al. [ 15 ] produced nation-wide tree-level carbon estimates for Rwanda using 0.25 0.25 m/px aerial RGB imagery and found that 48.6% of Rwanda’s aboveground carbon stock in trees was located outside forests. They also found that “even very detailed manual forest delineation…missed 38.4 % 38.4\% of the isolated trees in Rwanda, which account for 25.5% of the national aboveground carbon stocks” (emphasis added). These studies establish that individual crown detection in open, scattered-tree environments is tractable, but depend on (often proprietary) sub-metre imagery and labelled data, motivating more transferable and label-efficient methods.
blocks.zh: 在衡量树木覆盖和生物量方面采用了几种常规方法,包括地块实地清查[10]、统计取样[11]和混合溶液配对地块与遥感共变物如光学、多光谱和LiDAR传感器[12、13、14]。 从那时起,卫星和无人机数据的机器学习和深层学习将场域从总体覆盖部分转向绘制每棵树的地图: 勃兰特等人. [5] 从0.5米的图像绘制了撒哈拉和萨赫勒130万公里2\mathrm{km}^{2}的超过18亿个王冠图; Tucker等人。 [2] 扩展至碳估计超过99亿棵树。 雷纳等人. [9] 发现29%的非洲树木覆盖面积位于以前被划为森林的地区之外. Mugabowindekwe 等人著. [15] 利用0.25 0.25米/px空中RGB图像为卢旺达编制全国树级碳估计,发现卢旺达树木中48.6%的地面碳储存位于森林之外。 他们还发现,“即使是非常详细的人工森林划界......。 卢旺达有38.4%的孤立树,占全国地表碳储量的25.5%”(着重部分由作者标明)。 这些研究确定,在露天、分散的树木环境中,个别冠状物的检测是可拉动的,但取决于(往往是专有的)亚米图像和贴有标签的数据,促使采用更可转移和贴有标签效率的方法。

blocks.en: Modern deep learning approaches focus on instance segmentation on RGB imagery (Table 1 summarises representative methods): DeepForest [ 16 ] established a RetinaNet-based baseline evaluated on the NeonTreeEvaluation benchmark [ 17 ] , while Detectree2 [ 18 ] applied Mask R-CNN [ 19 ] to tropical crown polygons. Tong & Zhang [ 20 ] applied StarDist [ 21 ] , a U-Net [ 22 ] backbone model applying star-convex polygons as proposals during the detection stage rather than the more commonly used axis-aligned bounding boxes, allowing for improved Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) performance and more accurate detections. This approach was designed as a solution to the challenging problem of individual tree crown instance segmentation in dense forest canopy, where crowns are often touching and overlapping, which can contribute to many valid detections being needlessly dropped due to the coarse tessellation of bounding box rectangles. Applying a different approach to a similar dense-canopy problem domain, the authors of the tropical rainforest SelvaMask dataset [ 23 ] utilised a DINO [ 24 ] (a DETR-family detector, unrelated to the self-supervised DINO backbones used here) based tree crown detection model coupled with a Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 25 ] for prediction mask generation, applied to instance segmentation in dense canopy rainforests. Similar concepts of utilising SAM for RS tasks as a second-stage mask generator by providing it with prompts underpins models such as RSPrompter [ 26 ] and BalSAM [ 27 ] , the latter both with and without the integration of a Digital Surface Model (DSM) depth map alongside RGB data.
blocks.zh: 现代深层学习方法侧重于对RGB图像进行实例分解(表1总结了代表性方法):DeepForest [16]建立了基于RetinaNet的基准,在NeonTree评价基准上评价[17],而Detectrie 2 [18]将Mask R-CNN [19]应用于热带冠状多边形. Tong & Zhang [20] 应用了StarDist [21],一种U-Net [22]主干模型,在探测阶段将星环多边形作为建议,而不是更常用的轴对齐边框,从而可以改进非马克思姆抑制(NMS)性能和更精确的探测. 这种方法旨在解决在密林冠中个别树冠的分化这一具有挑战性的问题,树冠经常触摸和重叠,这可以促使许多有效的探测器由于捆绑箱矩形的粗糙条纹而被无谓地掉落. 热带雨林SelvaMask数据集的作者对类似的密闭式问题领域采用不同的方法,利用了DINO [24](一种DETR-家族探测器,与此处使用的自我监督的DINO主干网无关)基于树冠探测模型和用于预测面罩生成的Sip Anything Model(SAM) [25],应用于密闭式雨林中的实例分化. 利用SAM作为第二级遮罩生成器的类似概念为它提供了提示,支撑了RSPrompter[26]和BalSAM[27]等模型,后者既包括数字表面模型(DSM)深度图,也包括RGB数据。

blocks.en: We aim to address the tree crown instance segmentation space from two angles underexplored in the literature, both largely stemming from the lack of availability of data. Firstly, existing approaches focus on dense-canopy forests, and overwhelmingly exclude biomes such as savannah and dryland. For example, the authors of Detectree2 deliberately exclude images with ≤ 40 % \leq 40\% tree canopy cover from their datasets [ 18 ] . In the DeepForest paper, Weinstein et al. highlight Onaqui, Utah (ONAQ) as the model’s worst-performing site since it is a “desert scrub site with a different vegetation structure from any of the training data” [ 16 ] . Secondly, in order to produce output individual tree crown instance polygon masks, existing models typically rely on mask annotations for training [ 28 , 29 , 30 , 18 , 31 , 32 ] , which need to be produced manually by human annotators.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是从文献中未充分探讨的两个角度处理树冠分层空间问题,这两个角度主要来自缺乏数据。 首先,现有方法侧重于高山密林,绝大多数方法将草原和旱地等生物群落排除在外。 例如,Detectree2的作者故意将树冠覆盖量为~40%\leq 40\%的图像排除在数据集之外[18]. 在DeepForest的论文中,Weinstein等人强调犹他州Onaqui(ONAQ)是该模型表现最差的地点,因为它是一个 " 植被结构不同于任何培训数据的沙漠洗涤点 " [16]。 其次,为了生产输出单个树冠实例多边形口罩,现有的型号一般依靠口罩说明来进行训练[28,29,30,18,31,32],这些口罩需要由人类注释者手工制作.

blocks.en: 1.1 Lack of sparse-canopy environments
blocks.zh: 1.1 缺乏贫瘠的环境

blocks.en: We recognise a number of contributing factors to the exclusion of sparse-canopy biomes: 1. the limitations of spatial resolution, since an accurate model of ITC cover is hard to create with most publicly available satellite RGB datasets at 5–10 m/px. In practical usage, high ( < 1 <1 m/px) or ultra-high ( ≤ 0.1 \leq 0.1 m/px) resolution is required for ITC [ 33 ] . For reference, in the OAM-TCD holdout set used in this work (439 images, 25,705 individual tree crowns), downsampling from the images’ native 0.1 m/px to a Ground Sample Distance (GSD) of 1 m (i.e. the real-world area corresponding to one pixel) results in 25.0% of tree crowns enclosing no complete pixel. At 2 m GSD, 57.0% of crowns enclose no complete pixel, and 22.6% have a bounding box narrower than a single pixel on at least one axis; 2. underrepresentation in high-quality annotated datasets. Conventional global tree cover maps such as Hansen et al. [ 34 ] have been shown to systematically underestimate tree cover in drylands [ 4 ] and are markedly less accurate outside closed-canopy forests [ 35 ] , and biomass and carbon products used for drylands [ 36 , 37 , 38 ] typically apply a single method to forest and dryland vegetation alike [ 2 ] . We speculate that this may also have led to a subtle vicious cycle: under-counting causes woody biomass in sparse-canopy biomes to appear too scarce to justify annotation effort, which in turn stymies further exploration of tree crown detection and instance segmentation in exactly the biomes where cover is most uncertain [ 6 ] . By way of illustration, in their study of 9.9 billion individual tree crowns in the Sahara/Sahel/Sudan region, Tucker et al. [ 2 ] found that “areas with scattered trees are often represented by zero values”, attributing this to “the fact that previous models are rarely developed, trained and validated with plots of very sparse tree cover”.
blocks.zh: 我们承认一些因素导致将缺氧的生物群落排除在外: 1. 空间分辨率的局限性,因为利用大多数公开的卫星RGB数据集5–10 m/px,很难建立国贸中心覆盖的准确模型。 在实际使用中,国贸中心需要高分辨率( < 1 < 1 m/px)或超高分辨率(\ 0.1\leq 0.1 m/px)[33]。 参考一下,在这部作品中使用的OAM-TCD(439张图像,25,705张个人树冠)中,从图像的原生0.1 m/px到1 m的地面采样距离(即对应一个像素的现实世界面积)的采样结果,25.0%的树冠没有完整的像素。 在2 m GSD时,57.0%的王冠没有装入完整的像素,22.6%的王冠有一个比至少一个轴上的单个像素更窄的边框;2. 在高质量的注释数据集中代表不足. 常规全球树皮覆盖图如汉森等人. [34] 已被证明系统地低估了旱地的树木覆盖率[4],在封闭林外明显不准确[35],用于旱地的生物量和碳产品[36、37、38] 通常对森林和旱地植被都采用单一方法[2]。 我们推测,这也可能导致一种微妙的恶性循环:计算不足造成小树冠生物群落中的木质生物量看起来太少,不足以证明作出说明是有理由的,而这反过来又阻碍了对树冠探测的进一步探索和在覆盖最不确定的生物群落中进行实例分化[6]。 例如,Tucker等人在对撒哈拉/萨赫勒/苏丹地区99亿个树冠的研究中。 [2] 发现“树木分散的地区往往以零值为代表”,将此归因于“以前的模式很少得到开发、培训和验证,树皮很少”。

blocks.en:
In short, the development of RS Computer Vision techniques for Tree Canopy monitoring in sparse-canopy areas has been underexplored, yet semi-arid ecosystems account for roughly half of the trend and 39–47% of the interannual variability in the global land carbon sink [ 39 ] , and drove the record 2011 sink [ 40 ] . Drylands as a whole (hyperarid, arid, semi-arid and dry sub-humid zones, using the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization category definitions) cover ∼ \sim 41.5% of the Earth’s land surface [ 6 ] and are expected to expand from this figure by 10–23% by the year 2100 [ 41 ] .
Recent datasets such as SelvaBox [ 3 ] & SelvaMask [ 23 ] have broadened geographic coverage of publicly available annotations, and the OAM-TCD dataset [ 33 ] in particular incorporates a variety of biomes across the globe, including urban, tundra, and savannah.
blocks.zh:
简言之,开发RS计算机视野技术,用于在稀疏的树冠地区进行树冠监测,但半干旱生态系统约占全球土地碳汇趋势的一半,占年度间变化的39-47%[39],并驱动了创纪录的2011年沉没[40]。 整个旱地(干旱、干旱、半干旱和亚湿润干旱地区,使用联合国粮食及农业组织的类别定义)覆盖了地球地面面积的41.5%,预计到2100年将比这一数字增加10-23%。
最近的数据集,如SelvaBox [3] & SelvaMask [23] 扩大了公开说明的地理范围,而OAM-TCD数据集[33]特别包括了全球的各种生物群落,包括城市、苔原和草原。

blocks.en: 1.2 Reliance on manual mask annotations
blocks.zh: 1.2 依靠手动口罩说明

blocks.en: Besides domain coverage and distribution, tree crown instance segmentation also remains understudied due to the lack of individual tree crown mask annotations in datasets [ 27 ] . Since crown polygons are slower and typically more expensive to annotate than boxes, box-supervised instance segmentation [ 42 , 43 , 44 ] offers a practical route to instance-level delineation without polygon labels. The recent rise of self-supervised backbones such as DINOv2 [ 45 ] and DINOv3 [ 46 ] has demonstrated that models pretrained on very large sets of diverse web imagery (1.7 billion images in the case of DINOv3-web) are capable of matching or even exceeding Earth-observation-specific foundation models (e.g. DINOv3-sat) on high-resolution RGB RS tasks, with the latter retaining an advantage chiefly in physically grounded regression such as canopy height estimation. Apples-to-apples comparison across this literature remains difficult however, as papers variously report AP 50 , AP 50:95 , instance- or semantic-F1 at differing IoU thresholds against boxes and/or polygons.
blocks.zh: 除了域覆盖和分布之外,树冠实例分解由于数据集中缺少单个树冠面罩说明[27],因此仍然没有得到足够的研究. 由于冠多边形比箱型更慢,而且通常比箱型更贵,所以箱型监督的实例分割[42,43,44]提供了一个没有多边形标签的实例级划分的实用途径. DINOv2[45]和DINOv3[46]等自控骨干最近兴起,表明在非常庞大的多种网络图像(DINov3-web为17亿图像)上预先训练的模型在高分辨率的RGB RS任务上能够匹配甚至超过地球观测特定的基础模型(如DINOv3-sat),后者主要保留在诸如树冠高度估计等基于物理的回归中的一种优势. 然而,在所有这些文献中,苹果与苹果的比较仍然很困难,因为各种文件都报告AP 50,AP 50:95, 实例-或语义-F1,在对盒子和/或多边形的不同IoU阈值上。

blocks.en: In this work we propose a 3-stage model “LACE” built on a frozen DINOv3-web (ViT-L/16) [ 46 ] encoder, with a 3.2M-parameter CenterNet-style [ 47 ] detector head, and a novel lightweight expectation-maximisation module that leverages latent commonality of the ground truth bounding box annotations. In other words, we ask the question: “can we leverage the vector space signature of the tree-ness within DINO latent feature vectors, based only on the commonality between rectangular bounding box examples, to isolate the trees/foreground from the background?” Our experiments across a range of biomes including temperate, tropical, xeric, and urban scenes, demonstrate that even with diverse tree species and background context, a latent commonality module is sufficient to infer and delineate objects of interest from rough rectangular annotations alone.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出一个基于一个冷冻的DINOv3-web(ViT-L/16)[46]编码器的3级模型“LACE”,其中有一个3.2M-参数网式的[47]探测器头,以及一个新的轻量级预期-放大模块,利用地面真象约束框说明的潜在共性。 换句话说,我们提出这样一个问题:“我们能否仅仅根据长方形边框示例之间的共性,利用DINO潜在特征矢量空间表示的树状向量,将树/前景与背景隔离开来?” 我们跨越温带、热带、 x和城市等一系列生物群落的实验表明,即使树木种类和背景不同,潜在的共性模块也足以从粗糙的长方形说明中推断和划分感兴趣的物体。

blocks.en: LACE achieves a mask AP 50 of 0.663 ± 0.001 0.663\pm 0.001 on the OAM-TCD holdout benchmark and a box F1 of 0.728 ± 0.003 0.728\pm 0.003 on NeonTreeEvaluation (evaluated at IoU = 0.4 =0.4 ). The creators of NeonTreeEvaluation propose 0.4 IoU as a suitable threshold for tree crown detection tasks based on comparative analysis of agreement and overlap between different human annotations of the same datasets, and we follow their convention on this dataset for direct comparison with their results.
blocks.zh: LACE在OAM-TCD搁置基准上实现了0.663±0.001 0.663\pm 0.001的面罩AP50,在NeonTree评价上实现了0.728±0.003 0.728\pm 0.003的框F1(在IoU = 0.4=0.4评价). NeonTreeEvaluation的创造者根据对同一数据集不同人类说明之间的一致和重叠的比较分析,提出0.4 IoU作为树冠探测任务的合适门槛,我们遵循他们在这个数据集上的约定,直接与结果进行比较.

blocks.en: By using only the hand-annotated bounding box annotations (which are sampled from 13 of the total 22 sites present in the test dataset), our model was able to match DeepForest’s published results of 0.719 F1, evaluated at IoU ≥ 0.4 \geq 0.4 . We also did not make use of a “canopy height model” (CHM) (a LiDAR derived height raster at 1 m spatial resolution), or any of the NeonTreeEvaluation dataset’s hyperspectral imagery, since our focus is the underexplored and data-scarce sparse-canopy context. By demonstrating the efficacy of LACE on RGB data alone, we hope our contribution to the remote sensing community will have a broader application to data-scarce contexts.

blocks.en: In summary, the lack of publicly available tree crown-annotated datasets generates a need for box-supervised, performant TCIS models suitable for diverse sparse-canopy contexts. Our contribution is deliberately orthogonal to dense-canopy tropical forest models, which we use as baselines for comparison in the Results section. In broad terms, most existing state-of-the-art models focus on improving the precision of delineation in dense environments. By contrast, our focus is on identifying tree crowns in sparse-canopy landscapes. Nevertheless, LACE is still able to demonstrate SOTA performance in apples-to-apples comparisons, even with less training data and box supervision. By leveraging the rich DINOv3 features which enable rich cross-biome transferability, LACE is, to the best of our knowledge, the strongest performing biome-agnostic model in the TCIS space as evidenced by results on the OAM-TCD benchmark.
blocks.zh: 简言之,由于缺乏公开的树冠附加说明的数据集,需要适合各种稀疏树冠背景的箱式、有表演能力的TCIS模型。 我们有意对密集的冠状热带森林模型作出正统贡献,我们在成果一节中将其作为比较的基线。 广义而言,大多数现有最先进的模型都注重于提高密集环境中的划界精度. 相比之下,我们的重点是在荒凉的林冠景观中识别树冠。 尽管如此,LACE仍然能够在苹果与苹果的比较中展示SOTA的性能,即使培训数据和箱监督也更少. 通过利用丰富的DINOv3特性,使丰富的跨生物体可转移性得以实现,LACE就我们所知,是TCIS空间中最强的生物Me-不可知模型,关于OAM-TCD基准的结果就证明了这一点。

blocks.en: In this work, we present:
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出:

blocks.en: • a) our model LACE, built on a DINOv3-web (ViT-L/16) backbone [ 46 ] , with a trained CenterNet-style detector head [ 47 ] that identifies crown centres for detection based on the DINO output embeddings. We assess the performance of this approach against existing models on two publicly available datasets: Restor’s OAM-TCD and DeepForest’s NEON annotation dataset. • b) a novel box-to-mask module designed to extract the commonality in latent space, using an Expectation-Maximisation (EM) algorithm to isolate “treeness” within the bounding box. Unlike other existing implementations such as EM-Adapt [ 48 ] , which amortises the E-step into a gradient-trained CNN with implicit cross-box sharing, we fit an explicit closed-form commonality mixture over frozen features. We exploit the similarities between signatures of composite embeddings within ground truth bounding boxes, thematically following previous works such as DiscoBox [ 49 ] and DDT [ 50 ] . In our model however, we align more closely with architectures such as STEGO [ 51 ] by utilising a World Model/JEPA [ 52 ] style approach, eschewing pixel-space calculations in favour of strictly latent space analysis. This approach is made possible by the capabilities of Meta’s DINOv3 encoder foundation model [ 46 ] , a Vision-transformer-based model trained on 1.7 Billion images using Self-supervised Learning.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The use of computer vision models to process aerial and satellite RGB imagery for the purposes of tree crown measurements has seen a number of advancements in recent years [ 32 ] . Two important benefits of RGB methods above other data modalities such as LiDAR or hyperspectral data-based methods are firstly the widespread availability of aerial RGB imagery, and secondly the high spatial resolution of that data up to and including submeter per pixel precision. Moreover, aerial RGB data can also be collected by UAVs (drones) with relative ease. Consequently, in recent years there has been a focus in the RS community on RGB datasets which can directly leverage Computer Vision deep learning models [ 53 ] especially in the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViT) [ 54 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了树冠测量的目的,利用计算机视觉模型处理空中和卫星RGB图像,近年来取得了一些进展[32]. RGB方法优于LiDAR或超光谱数据基方法等其他数据模式的两个重要好处首先是空中RGB图像的广泛可得性,其次是该数据高达并包括每像素精度子米的高空间分辨率. 此外,空中RGB数据也可以相对容易地由无人驾驶航空器(drones)收集. 因此,在最近几年里,塞族共和国社区一直注重RGB数据集,这些数据集可以直接利用计算机视野深层学习模型[53],特别是在使用革命神经网络(CNN)和视野变换器(ViT)[54]方面。

blocks.en: We follow Ball et al. [ 18 ] in defining Tree Crown Instance Segmentation (TCIS) as the precise delineation of individual tree crowns. Since individual trees are the fundamental unit that aggregates to biomass over a landscape [ 55 ] and therefore carbon sequestration, in this work we focus on TCIS. Other related categories include Tree Crown Detection (TCD) models, which aim to detect instances of a given object and delineate them with a rectangular bounding box e.g. YOLO family [ 56 ] , and Semantic Segmentation (TCSS) models [ 57 , 58 ] which aim to categorise each pixel into a class. We use the TCIS acronym rather than other (perfectly reasonable) proposed conventions such as Tree Crown Detection and Delineation (TCDD) [ 29 ] or Individual Tree Crown Detection and Delineation (ITDCD) [ 32 ] , primarily to distinguish clearly and unambiguously between the above downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们跟随Ball等人[18],将树冠分立(TCIS)定义为个别树冠的精确划定. 由于单个树木是将生物物质聚集在地貌上的基本单位[55],因此也是碳固存,因此,在这项工作中,我们侧重于TCIS。 其他相关类别包括树冠检测(TCD)模型,其目的是检测特定物体的事例,并用一个矩形的边框来划分它们,例如YOLO家族[56],以及语义分裂(TCSS)模型[57,58],目的是将每个像素分类为一个类. 我们使用TCIS的缩写,而不是其他(完全合理的)拟议公约,如树冠检测和定界公约[29]或个别树冠检测和定界公约[32],主要是为了明确和毫不含糊地区分上述下游任务。

blocks.en: 2.1 Tree Crown Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 树冠模型

blocks.en: Modern CNN-based object detection models are comprised of three parts: 1. a feature extractor network (‘backbone’) which is a neural network that scans with convolutions to pick up on features in the image, with simpler features typically extracted earlier in the network’s layers and more complex composite features requiring greater depth [ 59 ] ; 2. a ‘neck’, which can merge the detections across different layers of the backbone and provide access to the whole gamut of feature scale and complexity; 3. the Detector ‘head(s)’, which take the encoded features as inputs and produce the entire CNN’s output, which can be, for example, bounding boxes around detected objects, polygons for a precise segmentation mask, or classification categories. Detector heads are generally either one-stage or two-stage detectors. Two-stage detectors first utilise a module to create many possible bounding boxes which are region proposals, before the second stage module extracts features from the proposals [ 60 ] . In this way, the model can accurately detect within a large image by focusing on high-probability smaller regions.
blocks.zh: 基于CNN的现代物体探测模型由三部分组成: 1. 特征提取器网络( " backbone " )是一个神经网络,它用演化扫描图像中的特征,其特征通常较简单,在网络各层较早时提取,复合特征更为复杂,需要更深的深度[59];2. " 颈部 " ,可以将不同层骨干上的探测器合并起来,提供对特征尺度和复杂性的全方位访问;3. 探测器 " 头部 " ,它把编码的特征作为输入,并产生整个CNN的输出,例如,可以将被探测物体周围的盒子、多边形作为精确的分层罩或分类类别。 探测器头一般为一级或两级探测器. 双阶段探测器首先利用一个模块,在第二阶段模块从提案中提取特征之前,创建许多可能是区域提案的边框。 通过这种方式,该模型可以通过关注高概率较小的区域,在大图像中准确检测.

blocks.en: One-stage detectors include YOLO (‘You Only Look Once’) series of models [ 56 , 61 ] , RetinaNet [ 62 ] and EfficientDet [ 63 ] . Within TCD, the dominant two-stage detectors descend from the Region-based CNN (R-CNN) [ 64 ] : Fast R-CNN [ 65 ] shares convolutional features across proposals, Faster R-CNN [ 66 ] replaces external proposals with a learned Region Proposal Network (RPN), and Mask R-CNN [ 19 ] extends Faster R-CNN with a parallel per-instance mask head, which is what makes it the standard architecture for TCIS.
blocks.zh: 一级探测器包括YOLO( " You Only Look Once " )系列型号[56,61],RetinaNet[62]和高效Det[63]. 在TCD内,占主导地位的两阶段探测器从基于区域的CNN(R-CNN)[64]:快速R-CNN[65]在各种提案之间共享进化特征,更快R-CNN[66]用学习型的区域提议网络(RPN)取代外部提议,而Mask R-CNN[19]则用平行的每层面具头来延伸更快R-CNN,这就是TCIS的标准架构.

blocks.en: 2.1.1 Star-convex

Star-convex representations offer a different route to separating touching crowns. Tong & Zhang [ 20 ] adapt StarDist [ 21 ] to tree crowns, replacing axis-aligned boxes with star-convex polygons so that NMS prunes overlapping proposals on crown geometry rather than box overlap, and report gains over Mask R-CNN and other SOTA models on dense, overlapping canopy in RGB imagery. MP-PolarMask [ 67 ] , although not a TCIS-domain model, extends the star-convex representation with auxiliary polar centres to capture concave shapes, which could perhaps be suitable for non-star-convex crowns such as palm trees. FG-TreeSeg [ 68 ] takes a different route: it starts from a canopy semantic mask, then applies Cellpose-SAM, a cell-segmentation model that predicts, for every canopy pixel, a flow vector pointing towards its crown centre. By following these vectors, pixels can be grouped by the centre they converge on, so touching crowns are split into instances without any instance annotations.
blocks.zh: 星形凸轮的表示提供了分离触摸王冠的另一种途径. Tong & Zhang [20] 将StarDist [21] 调整为树冠,用星孔多边形取代轴对齐的箱,使NMS在冠几何而不是箱重叠上进行重叠的建议,并在RGB图像中报告对Mask R-CNN和其他SOTA模型的增益,对密集,重叠的树冠. MP-PolarMask [67],虽然不是TCIS-域模型,但将星孔代表器与辅助极地中心相扩展,以捕捉凸轮形状,可能适合棕榈树等非星孔冠. FG-TreeSeg [68] 采取了不同的路线:它从一个树冠语义面具开始,然后应用Cellpose-SAM,一种细胞分隔模型,它预言,对于每个树冠像素,一个向它的冠中心指向的流矢量. 通过跟随这些向量,像素可以被它们聚集在的中心组合起来,因此触摸的冠被分割成没有实例说明的例.

blocks.en: 2.1.2 DeepForest

DeepForest [ 16 ] is a significant baseline model in Tree Crown Detection (TCD). DeepForest is a RetinaNet on a ResNet50 backbone and Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) trained on over 30 million LiDAR-prompted algorithmically generated crowns from 22 National Ecological Observatory Network (NEON) sites and further fine-tuned using 10,000 hand-annotated crowns.
blocks.zh: DeepForest [16] 是树冠检测(TCD)中一个重要的基准模型. DeepForest是一个位于ResNet50主干线和地物金字塔网络(FPN)上的RetinaNet,从22个国家生态观测网络(NEON)站点对超过3000万立达催生算法生成的金字塔冠进行了培训,并使用10,000个手饰金字塔冠进行了进一步的微调.

blocks.en: 2.1.3 Pretrained Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2.1.3 预先培训的基金会模式

blocks.en: Detectron2 [ 69 ] is the object detection and segmentation library on which several of the tree crown baselines in this work are built, including Detectree2 and Restor’s Mask R-CNN; it supplies the Mask R-CNN, RetinaNet and Faster R-CNN reference implementations together with the training, inference and evaluation harness used to fine-tune them.
blocks.zh: Detectron2[69]是本工程中树冠基线的数个立体探测和分解库,包括Detectree2和Restor的面具R-CNN;它提供了面具R-CNN、RetinaNet和更快的R-CNN参考执行,以及用来微调它们的训练、推论和评价工具。

blocks.en: Meta’s Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 25 ] , now in its third iteration [ 70 ] , is a promptable class-agnostic segmentation foundation model: given a point, box or mask prompt it emits an instance mask, which makes it a natural box-to-mask module for detectors that emit only rectangles, and it is used in that role by several of the baselines compared here.
blocks.zh: Meta's September Anything Model (SAM) [25],现处于第三代[70],是一个可快速的类不可知分解基础模型:如果一个点,盒子或面具提示它会发出一个实例面具,它就成为只发出矩形的探测器的自然箱对掩体模块,它被这里比较的几个基线用作这个角色.

blocks.en: Meta’s latest version of the Self-Distillation with No Labels (DINO) family [ 71 , 45 ] is DINOv3 [ 46 ] : a SOTA encoder trained with fully Self-Supervised Learning on 1.7 billion images pulled from various online sources. Utilising SSL facilitates training regimes on orders of magnitude more image data since weakly and fully supervised methods typically require high-quality labels and/or metadata for the training images [ 72 , 73 , 74 ] . Highly context-agnostic, DINOv3-web is an example of a single frozen SSL backbone that can serve as a “universal visual encoder” [ 46 ] capable of generating rich embedding vectors that capture the semantic information from the raw pixel patches in context. Incorporating both a global image-level objective and a local iBOT-style [ 75 ] patch-level latent reconstruction objective in the loss function results in a model that excels at encoding global and local features. In this work, we use the DINOv3-web ViT-L distilled model, with a native 16 16 px patch.

blocks.en: SelvaBox [ 3 ] is a UAV-captured RGB dataset of tropical dense-canopy forest in Panama, Brazil, and Ecuador, composed of 83,000 ITC manual bounding box annotations. Its authors publish a DINO (DETR) [ 24 ] Swin-L based model trained on NeonTreeEvaluation (see Datasets), OAM-TCD, and another dataset called QuebecTrees, which achieves a best result of box mAP 50:95 of 44.29 ± 0.33 44.29\pm 0.33 on OAM-TCD holdout set, improving upon DeepForest ( 39.00 ± 0.21 39.00\pm 0.21 ) and a Faster R-CNN ResNet50 ( 38.34 ± 0.26 38.34\pm 0.26 ) finetuned on the same data. A second related dataset, SelvaMask [ 23 ] , provides ITC instance segmentation masks and assesses the SelvaBox detection model (also referred to by the authors as ‘SelvaBox’) in combination with both frozen and fine-tuned SAM 3 decoder modules on the OAM-TCD dataset for the TCIS task. The authors compare results on a number of benchmark datasets including OAM-TCD alongside Detectree2 and DeepForest with a similar frozen SAM 3 mask prediction module. SelvaMask’s focus is increased precision of tree crown boundaries in dense canopy, whereas our focus is on sparse-canopy detection accuracy. They note that their model is specialised “to dense, interlocking canopies, slightly reducing its transferability to temperate forests”.

blocks.en: The OAM-TCD dataset [ 33 ] , introduced by Veitch-Michaelis et al. (ETH Zurich, Restor and collaborators), uses OpenAerialMap (OAM) RGB imagery and provides 5072 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 px images at 0.1 m/px resolution with associated human-labelled instance masks for over 280k individual and 56k groups of trees (groups are hereafter referred to as “canopy”). In our work, the OAM-TCD dataset has been an invaluable benchmark to assess the comparative performance of our LACE model in an apples-to-apples comparison against other SOTA models, due to the inclusion of not only bounding boxes but also precise polygon masks, as well as its broad range of ecological biomes to capture the diversity and morphology of trees in different terrestrial biomes including both urban and natural environments. blocks.en: The U.S. National Science Foundation’s National Ecological Observatory Network (NEON) publicly available aerial imagery dataset is a cornerstone of RS research, comprising 22 separate locations across the continental United States and including a variety of different biomes. The DeepForest model released alongside the NeonTreeEvaluation benchmark [ 17 ] was pretrained on all 22 sites, using an unsupervised LiDAR-based algorithm [ 79 ] to generate millions of moderate-quality annotations, and was then fine-tuned on a further 10,000 manual annotations of RGB imagery from six sites. The quality and scale of the NEON dataset as well as its fundamental role in the development of the DeepForest model was a key reason to build our pipeline to natively support the NEON resolution of 0.1 m/px.
blocks.zh: 美国国家科学基金会公开提供的国家生态观测网(NEON)航空图像数据集是RS研究的基石,由整个美国大陆的22个不同地点组成,包括各种不同的生物群落. 与NeonTree Evaluation基准[17]一同发布的DeepForest模型在所有22个站点进行了预先的训练,使用一个无人监督的LiDAR算法[79]生成数百万个中等质量的说明,然后在另外1万个手动说明中微调了来自6个站点的RGB图像. 近地天体网数据集的质量和规模及其在开发深森林模型方面的基本作用,是建设我们的管道以本土支持0.1 m/px的近地天体网分辨率的一个关键原因。

blocks.en: Data preprocessing: We pinned NeonTreeEvaluation @1.8.0 and built the evaluation GT by intersecting annotation XMLs with RGB tiles. This resulted in 194 scored tiles / 6,634 boxes / 22 sites. We downloaded the hand-annotated RGB training tiles, which are spatially disjoint from the evaluation tiles, and cropped 18 kept tiles (13 sites, 23,424 source boxes) into 2,063 non-overlapping 400 400 px patches (26,800 boxes after clipping to patch bounds), restricted to genuinely-annotated regions only and capping empty negatives at 0.3 × 0.3\times positives per tile. Two tiles were dropped due to low annotation coverage (SJER 41.8% / TOOL 0% coverage). The train/val split is patch-level stratified (every 8th patch of each tile, 1,807 train / 256 val), so all sites appear in training; val is used only as the early-stopping signal and the reported metric is the fully disjoint 194-tile benchmark.

blocks.en: 3.2 LACE
blocks.zh: 3.2 液压

blocks.en: The method converts a frozen self-supervised encoder into instance masks for individual tree crowns using bounding-box supervision only. It has three stages: a dense feature grid obtained by interlacing four offset passes of a frozen DINOv3-web ViT (Section 3.2.1 ); an anchor-free detector trained on bounding boxes (Section 3.2.2 ); and a training-free box-to-mask module that converts each predicted box into a mask by foreground/background discrimination in a whitened feature space (Section 3.2.3 ). Predictions are then ranked by combining the detector score with the mask module’s own posterior (Section 3.2.5 ), which adds no parameter and leaves the masks untouched. No crown polygon is read at any stage of encoding, detection or mask fitting. The only mask labels used anywhere in the pipeline are the validation images on which the three inference scalars are selected (Section 3.2.4 ).
blocks.zh: 该方法将冷冻的自我监督编码器转换成单个树冠的口罩,只使用边框监督. 它分三个阶段:将冻结的DINOv3-web VIT(第3.2.1节)的4个相向通道相接而获得的密集特性网格;在捆绑箱上训练的无锚探测器(第3.2.2节);以及将每个预测的盒子转换成面具的无训练箱-任务模块,在白色特性空间中通过前缘/后缘的歧视(第3.2.3节)。 然后通过将探测器的分数与面具模块自己的后缀(第3.2.5节)结合起来来进行预测,后者没有增加参数,并且没有使面具受到影响。 在编码、检测或面具装配的任何阶段,都不会读出冠状多边形。 管道中任何地方使用的唯一口罩标签是三个推断标尺所选择的验证图像(第3.2.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Detection

Detection uses an anchor-free centre-based head operating directly on F ~ \widetilde{F} at stride 8 8 . A 1 × 1 1\times 1 stem projects 1024 1024 channels to width 256 256 , followed by five 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional blocks with group normalisation and ReLU ( 3.2 3.2 M parameters in total; 4.0 4.0 M with the 4096 4096 -dimensional NEON input), and two 1 × 1 1\times 1 output heads: a single-channel centre heatmap and a four-channel regression map carrying a local sub-cell offset and log box size. This is based on the CenterNet design [ 47 ] . The heatmap bias is initialised to − 2.19 -2.19 so the initial centre probability is ≈ 0.1 \approx 0.1 , and the size biases are initialised to a 20 20 px crown at stride 8 8 .

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Training-free box-to-mask conversion

blocks.en: Given a box, the task remains to decide which of its cells belong to the crown. We treat this as foreground/background discrimination in a whitened feature space, with the model fitted once on training tiles using boxes only and then held fixed.
blocks.zh: 由于一个盒子,任务仍然是决定哪个细胞属于王冠. 在白色的地物空间中,我们将此视为前地/后地歧视,在训练瓷砖上安装过一次,只使用盒子,然后固定。

blocks.en: The module has four key components: a whitened feature space; a frozen background mixture; a set of foreground prototypes; and a spatial prior over relative position within the box. The last two are learned by an alternating EM-based fit, while the first two stay fixed.
blocks.zh: 该模块有四个关键组成部分:一个白色的特征空间;一个冷冻的背景混合物;一套前方原型;以及一个空间先于盒子内的相对位置. 后两种是通过一个基于EM的交替配体学习的,而前两种则固定不变.

blocks.en: LACE’s core idea is to leverage the rich DINOv3-web embeddings as sufficiently descriptive representations of each patch to build a high-performing tree-crown instance segmentation model. We begin with a a , a given cell’s raw unmodified embedding, and PCA-whiten it: a a is centred, projected onto the leading d = 128 d=128 principal directions of the training-cell distribution, and rescaled so that each retained component has unit variance. A final L 2 L_{2} normalisation then places the result on the unit sphere, giving the unit vector z z . z ~ = ( a − μ ) ​ W λ , z = z ~ ∥ z ~ ∥ , \tilde{z}\;=\;\frac{(a-\mu)\,W}{\lambda},\qquad z\;=\;\frac{\tilde{z}}{\lVert\tilde{z}\rVert}, (2) Here a ∈ ℝ 1024 a\in\mathbb{R}^{1024} is one cell of F ~ \widetilde{F} ; the cell mean μ ∈ ℝ 1024 \mu\in\mathbb{R}^{1024} , the whitening matrix W ∈ ℝ 1024 × d W\in\mathbb{R}^{1024\times d} whose columns are the retained principal directions, and the scale vector λ ∈ ℝ d \lambda\in\mathbb{R}^{d} of the corresponding singular values are all estimated once on training cells and then frozen. This whitening/spherising equalises the variance of the retained directions so that no direction dominates by scale alone. The final normalisation then places every cell on the unit sphere, making all subsequent comparisons simple cosine similarities and allowing both foreground and background to be modelled by von Mises–Fisher components [ 81 ] with a shared concentration κ \kappa .

This is merely a heuristic to kick-start the fitting. Without this restriction, the initialisation is seeded from in-box background elements such as soil and roads, which are numerous and not the intended crown foreground.

blocks.en: We observe that a crown typically occupies a roughly central and roughly circular region of a reasonably tight GT box. We encode this as a spatial prior ρ \rho over the crown’s relative position within the box, to push the model towards producing reasonable tree crown-like prediction masks. In particular, we aim to increase LACE’s robustness to dense-canopy and lush undergrowth situations, where the box-to-mask module can unintentionally produce masks that are not tree crown-like. The box is divided into an N × N N\times N grid of bins in normalised coordinates ( u , v ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] 2 (u,v)\in[0,1]^{2} . Because those coordinates are a fraction of the box, ρ \rho is by construction invariant to crown size, tile size and ground sample distance. Priors are maintained separately for three crown-size bands, whose edges are the terciles of the training box-size distribution, since at a fixed feature stride the number of cells spanning a crown depends on its size. Taken together, ρ \rho therefore carries one value for each (size band, prototype, u u bin, v v bin) combination: it is a joint prior over where in the box a cell sits and which prototype is expected there. We write ρ ^ k = ρ k / ∑ k ′ ρ k ′ \hat{\rho}_{k}=\rho_{k}/\sum_{k^{\prime}}\rho_{k^{\prime}} for the prior at a bin normalised across prototypes, so that ρ ^ \hat{\rho} is a distribution over the K f ​ g K_{fg} prototypes at that bin while the unnormalised total ∑ k ρ k \sum_{k}\rho_{k} remains the probability that the bin is crown at all. Equations ( 4 ) and ( 6 ) draw on these two quantities separately. ρ \rho is initialised uniform, so all prototypes begin with identical spatial profiles and differentiate only through Equation ( 10 ).

blocks.en: Two constraints are applied to ρ \rho at every M-step. The first pins its mean per-bin foreground mass, summed over prototypes and averaged over the N 2 N^{2} bins, to π / 4 ≈ 0.785 \pi/4\approx 0.785 , the area fraction of an ellipse inscribed in its bounding box and hence independent of box aspect ratio. The second caps any single bin at 0.95 0.95 , so that no relative position is ever treated as certainly foreground. Pinning the mass to a constant derived from geometry rather than fitted is what keeps the prior label-free, and it means the fit decides only where the foreground mass sits, never how much of it there is: without the constraint ρ \rho inflates towards unity, stops discriminating position, and the α \alpha term of Equation ( 6 ) degenerates into an additive constant. 2 2 2 The two constraints are not simultaneously satisfiable. On the deployed fit the rescaling is partly undone by the per-bin cap, leaving a realised mean per-bin mass of 0.690 0.690 against the nominal 0.785 0.785 .

blocks.en: Equation ( 5 ) is the second filter, and the step that makes the model work on frozen ViT features. Problematically, attention over the surrounding tile inflates the absolute foreground score of every cell inside a box, so A A is confounded by context and its absolute level is not sufficiently informative: e.g. soil surrounded by canopy can still score positively, and therefore survive the first filter. However, recentring isolates A A within a box, asking not whether a cell is crown-like but whether it is more crown-like than the rest of its own box. The behaviour that follows is what we wanted to produce: a heterogeneous box containing crown and soil has a wide spread of A ¯ \bar{A} and is carved appropriately, whereas a box in uniformly closed canopy has a narrow spread and stays closer to filled, which is generally correct.

blocks.en: Equation ( 6 ), the posterior, adds the only box-dependent term, and it is worth noting that the spatial prior enters the two equations in different roles. In Equation ( 4 ) it appears only as the normalised weight ρ ^ k \hat{\rho}_{k} , which sums to one over k k and therefore selects which prototype applies at a given relative position while discarding how much total foreground prior there is. That discarded total re-enters on its own in Equation ( 6 ), where the prior weight α \alpha scales it. The appearance term A ¯ \bar{A} is thus entirely box-independent, and Equation ( 6 ) contains the only point at which box geometry influences the posterior. Equation ( 6 ) gives the probability that a cell is crown, but the M-step also needs to know which prototype accounts for it. The E-step therefore returns a second quantity, the responsibilities r n ​ k r_{nk} : r n ​ k = p f ​ g ​ ( z n ) ​ ρ k ​ exp ⁡ ( κ ​ z n ⊤ ​ C k ) ∑ k ′ ρ k ′ ​ exp ⁡ ( κ ​ z n ⊤ ​ C k ′ ) , r_{nk}\;=\;p_{fg}(z_{n})\;\frac{\rho_{k}\exp\!\left(\kappa\,z_{n}^{\top}C_{k}\right)}{\sum_{k^{\prime}}\rho_{k^{\prime}}\exp\!\left(\kappa\,z_{n}^{\top}C_{k^{\prime}}\right)}, (7) which distribute each cell’s foreground probability over the K f ​ g K_{fg} prototypes in proportion to the weighted components of Equation ( 4 ), so that ∑ k r n ​ k = p f ​ g ​ ( z n ) \sum_{k}r_{nk}=p_{fg}(z_{n}) . blocks.en: For TCIS, only OAM-TCD is a suitable end-to-end evaluation dataset since it contains instance masks which are required for test-time evaluation. We restrict our evaluation to OAM-TCD’s Tree class (cat=1). One approach in the literature [ 3 ] , which we agree with and utilize, is to ignore all canopy annotations (cat=2) altogether. Unsurprisingly, the model’s predictions often fall inside areas marked as canopy, which contain many closely grouped and entirely valid tree crowns, but we do not attribute any positive or negative score to these predictions and they are excluded from the evaluation metrics entirely (SelvaBox deletes all pixels in canopy areas; we instead use COCO’s iscrowd=1 to ignore them). The rationale here is that the annotating of canopy into groups necessarily leads to subjective groupings. For example, should a clump of 10 tree crowns be best delineated by 1 canopy of 10 crowns, or 2 of 5? We claim both are equally valid, and by using subjective groupings, the AP 50 metric becomes corrupted since IoU > 0.5 \mathrm{IoU}>0.5 is based on agreement of delineations. Every OAM-TCD figure we report is therefore "canopy-neutral", unless otherwise specified.
blocks.zh: 对于TCIS来说,只有OAM-TCD是合适的端到端评价数据集,因为它包含了测试时间评价所需的实例口罩. 我们的评价仅限于OAM-TCD的树类(cat=1). 我们同意并使用的文献[3]中的一个方法是完全忽略所有树冠说明(cat=2)。 毫不奇怪,模型的预测往往落在被标记为树冠的区域内,这些树冠包含许多紧密组合和完全有效的树冠,但我们并没有将这些预测归结为正值或负值,它们被完全排除在评价指标之外(SelvaBox删除树冠地区的所有像素;而我们使用COCO的树冠=1来忽略它们). 这里的理由是,将树冠标注成群体必然导致主观的分组. 例如,10棵树冠的花冠最好由10棵树冠的1棵树冠或5棵树的2棵树冠来划定? 我们主张两者同样有效,通过使用主观分类,AP 50 度量衡变得腐败,因为IoU > 0.5\mathrm{IoU}>0.5是基于划界协议。 因此,我们报告的每个OAM-TCD数字都是“无敌的”,除非另有说明。

blocks.en: We ablate the three central contributions: the interlaced feature grid, the training-free box-to-mask module, and the ranking rule that multiplies the module’s posterior into the detector score. blocks.en: 5.1 A note of caution

blocks.en: Taking a step back, the conversation relating to the carbon sequestration of trees globally requires some nuance. In a warming world, it is tempting to reduce the objective to something along the lines of ’tree maximalism’ i.e. more trees is always better. However, as discussed by [ 4 ] , it is vital to factor in the biomes and environments before drawing unfounded conclusions about
blocks.zh: 在退一步后,有关全球树木碳固存的对话需要一些细微差别。 在气候变暖的世界里, 将目标降低到树的极限, 然而,正如[4]所讨论的,在对生物群落和环境作出毫无根据的结论之前,必须考虑到这些生物群落和环境。

blocks.en: 5.2 TCIS
blocks.zh: 5.2 货物预报信息系统

blocks.en: On the 439-image OAM-TCD test set, LACE scores the highest AP 50 of 0.663 and effectively ties with Restor’s Mask R-CNN at AP 50:95 despite some significant limitations. Foremost is its handicapped training regime of only boxes rather than masks, and also its limited training set of 900 images rather than 4169. LACE appears competitive with fully supervised models and therefore presents a viable option for TCIS tasks utilising much more time- and cost-efficient box annotations, and has demonstrated efficacy over a wide range of biomes. This is made possible by the quality of the DINOv3-web encoder, which, through its massive pretraining set of 1.7 billion images, not to mention its authors’ numerous innovations, is highly robust to domain transfer. In this way, LACE presents a new approach to TCIS, particularly for sparse-canopy environments where the focus is less on precise delineation and instead on measuring tree crown count, size, and allometries over large, diverse landscapes.
blocks.zh: 在439-image OAM-TCD测试集上,LACE在0.663中得分最高的AP 50,并在AP 50:95中与Restor的Mask R-CNN有效联系,尽管有一些重大限制. 最主要的是其只有盒子而不是面具的残疾人培训制度,还有其900幅图像的有限培训,而不是4169幅。 LACE似乎具有完全受监督的模型的竞争力,因此为货物预报信息系统的任务提供了可行的选择,使用时间和成本效益高得多的方框说明,并显示出对各种生物群落的功效。 DINov3-web编码器的质量使得这一点成为可能,通过它庞大的17亿图像预训集,更不用说它的作者们的众多创新,它对于域域传输非常有力。 通过这种方式,LACE对TCIS提出了一种新的方法,特别是对于小树冠环境,其重点较少于精确划定,而在于测量树冠计数、大小和大而多样的景观上的杂食。

blocks.en: By taking the 8 8 px interlaced grid as the unit of crown delineation, LACE concedes an inbuilt disadvantage relative to pixel-based maskers, namely that it is fundamentally limited to a coarser resolution. This would be expected to cost most at high IoU thresholds such as AP 75 , AP 90 , but less at AP 50 , where boundary precision is less strict. This is borne out in the narrowing gap between LACE’s AP 50 lead of 0.037 vs its AP 50:95 which is within seed noise of Restor’s Mask R-CNN.

blocks.en: 5.3 Comment on crown annotations in dense canopy
blocks.zh: 5.3 对密集树冠图案的说明

blocks.en: Helpfully, NeonTreeEvaluation contains many GT annotations within dense canopy areas, annotated individually allowing for precise individual instance segmentation evaluation even in canopy areas. Existing datasets that try to provide instance segmentation labels very often will tend to attempt to draw definitive ‘ground truth’ on dense canopy where there arguably is simply not enough information in the image to make that determination definitively [ 18 , 83 ] . There are a variety of potential solutions to this challenge, and naturally, there is a need for pragmatism in annotating a close approximation of the actual ground truth in a scenario where it is impossible to be certain. Nevertheless, we observe that it is characteristic of datasets that annotate individual tree crowns in dense canopy scenarios, either with rectangular bounding boxes or closed polygons/masks, to leave a large number of gaps between units. As an approximation and indeed for pixel-wise classification loss, this can be sufficient, but introduces some important nuance when it comes to inference-time test set benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 助益的是,NeonTreeEvaluation在密集的树冠区域中包含许多GT说明,个别地附加说明,甚至可以在树冠区域进行精确的单个实例分类评价. 试图提供实例分解标签的现有数据集往往会试图在密布的树冠上画出明确的 " 基础真相 " ,因为可以论证的是,图像中根本没有足够的信息来确定这种确定[18,83]。 这一挑战有各种潜在的解决办法,自然,在无法确定的情况下,需要务实地对实际地面真相作近似描述。 然而,我们观察到,数据集的特点是,在密集的树冠情景中,用长方形边框或闭合的多边形/面板对单个树冠进行注释,从而在单位之间留下大量空白。 作为一种近似,甚至对于像素类分类损失来说,这可以足够,但在推论时间测试设定基准时引入了一些重要的细微差别.

blocks.en: Firstly, where GT annotations leave non-trivial gaps between annotation boundaries, a model that produces more inclusive, justified boundaries can be penalised. Secondly, pycocotools’ standard mean average precision (mAP 50 ) is based on Intersection over Union (IoU) and, for each ground truth (can be bounding box or polygon), algorithmically looks for predictions that overlap with the ground truth, ordered by confidence score (descending). If one is found that exceeds 0.5, i.e., the area of intersection between prediction and ground truth (GT) is 50% or more of the union of the two, that prediction is counted as a True Positive (TP). In annotated dense canopy, this entails that the resulting benchmark contains some subjectivity, i.e., many predictions that are defensible and possibly even more accurate than the ground truth can be counted as False Positives (FP). This is particularly an issue with RGB imagery that includes trees of varying scales i.e. smaller and larger, as a mismatched scale between prediction and GT leads to much higher FP rates since (m)AP 50 is highly sensitive to scale mismatch for purely geometric reasons: a small prediction’s overlap with a large GT is much less likely to cross the 50% IoU threshold, and equally a large prediction’s overlap with a small GT is much less likely to cross it. If one of the two is less than 50% of the area of the other, it will be counted as a FP regardless of placement. In contexts such as dense canopy where, for example, a single large crown could be one tree or two trees, the metric is sensitive to the arbitrary choice of division. The same is true of Precision, Recall, and F1 metrics derived from instance predictions (not including area-/pixel-based Precision, Recall, or F1 metrics which are calculated over total pixels rather than individual bounding boxes or polygons).
blocks.zh: 首先,当GT说明在注释边界之间留下非三角差距时,可以惩罚产生更具包容性、合理边界的模式。 其次,pycocotools的标准平均精度(mAP 50 )是基于Intersection over Union(IoU),对于每个地面真理(可以是边框或多边形),算法性地寻找与地面真理相重叠的预测,由信心分数(降级)命令. 如果发现一个超过0.5,即预测与地面真理(GT)的交汇面积为两者结合的50%或以上,那么这个预测就算作真阳性(TP). 在附加说明的密集树冠中,这就要求由此产生的基准包含一些主观性,即许多可以辩驳而且可能比地面真实性更准确的预测可以算作假阳性(FP). 这尤其与包含不同尺度的树,即大小不一的RGB图像有关,因为预测和GT不匹配的尺度会导致高得多的FP率,因为(m)AP 50由于纯粹几何原因对尺度不匹配高度敏感:一个小的预测与一个大的GT重叠的可能性要小得多地超过50%IoU阈值,一个大的预测与一个小的GT重叠的可能性也小得多. 如果两者之一的面积低于另一者面积的50%,则无论位置如何,都会算作FP. 在密集树冠等情况下,例如,一个单一的大冠可能是一棵树或两棵树,度量衡对任意选择划分很敏感. 从实例预测中得出的精度、回溯和F1度量也是一样(不包括以区域/像素为基础的精度、回溯或F1度量,这些度量是相对于总像素而不是单个边框或多边形计算的)。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this study we present LACE, a domain-agnostic model for instance segmentation in box-supervised Tree Crown tasks, where annotations are scarce. Our box-to-mask inference method, by leveraging the statistical signature of the DINOv3 latent composite, provides a SOTA-competitive solution to true Tree Crown Instance Segmentation (TCIS) without the need for time-consuming and/or expensive polygon masks. With this contribution, we hope to support the Remote Sensing community in the previously underexplored area of TCD and TCIS in diverse global biomes, particularly sparse-canopy landscapes. We also believe the designs discussed here could be transferable to other Computer Vision domains where availability of annotated data is also a known challenge, since we did not rely on domain-specific priors to any significant degree, although this is beyond the scope of this work.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们介绍了LACE,一种域不可知模型,例如,在箱式监督的树冠任务中进行分割,说明很少。 通过利用DINOv3潜在复合材料的统计标志,我们的箱对任务推论方法提供了一种SOTA-竞争性的解决方案,用于真正的树冠实例分解(TCIS),而不需要耗费时间和/或昂贵的多边形面具。 有了这一贡献,我们希望在以前未充分开发的TD和TCIS地区支持遥感界的各种全球生物群落,特别是贫瘠的峡谷景观。 我们还认为,这里所讨论的设计可以转让给其他计算机远景领域,因为提供附加说明的数据也是一个众所周知的挑战,因为我们没有在很大程度上依赖特定领域的前科,尽管这超出了这项工作的范围。

blocks.en: We deploy β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 , but Table 10 shows that β = 0 \beta=0 with recentring reaches the same accuracy, and the reason is that the two subtractions remove the same thing. Repulsion subtracts the background signature from each prototype once, at the M-step (Equation ( 9 )); recentring subtracts the box mean from each cell’s log-ratio at the E-step (Equation ( 5 )), and that mean is dominated by the background the box shares with its surroundings. Either removal on its own separates crown from background; applying both removes little more, which is the negative interaction in Table 10 . On validation, β = 0 \beta=0 with recentring matches the deployed masker on AP 50:95 ( 0.2680 0.2680 for both) and sits 0.0014 0.0014 AP 50 above it, inside the detector-seed band. What β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 has instead is identifiability (i.e. it generates an explicit “treeness direction”): refit at three EM seeds and at two values of K f ​ g K_{fg} it recovers the same direction every time ( cos ⁡ 0.9915 \cos 0.9915 to 0.9942 0.9942 ), whereas the β = 0 \beta=0 mixture spreads the same foreground over sixteen prototypes whose individual identities are not determined by the data. With neither subtraction applied, masks occupy much more of the box corners and mask AP 50 on the 439 439 -tile holdout drops from 0.6203 0.6203 to 0.5790 0.5790 (tested with the fit-time scalars α = 1 \alpha=1 , κ = 10 \kappa=10 and identical detection set).

blocks.en: COCO’s crowd rule scores intersection over detection area, so at a threshold of 0.50 0.50 it coincides exactly with the “more than half the prediction lies in canopy” rule used elsewhere in this literature. Both were computed and compared rather than assumed equivalent. Canopy-ignore is genuinely free: an ignored detection is removed from the true-positive and false-positive counts alike, so predicting into unlabelled canopy costs nothing. This matters most for SelvaBox, which never saw canopy during training.
blocks.zh: COCO的人群规则得分比探测区域相交,因此在0.50 0.50的临界值上,它恰好与本文其他文献中使用的“一半以上的预测在于树冠”规则相吻合。 两者都是计算和比较的,而不是假定的相等。 Canopy-ignore是真正自由的:被忽略的检测从真实的阳性和假的阳性计数中去除,因此预测无标签的Canopy成本是一无所有. 这对塞尔瓦博克斯最为重要,后者在训练期间从未见过树冠.

blocks.en: The cap of 600 600 detections per tile is our protocol choice.
